products.name: Sacred Ajwa Al-Madinah (VIP Grade)
products.description: Directly sourced from the ancient palm groves of Al-Madinah Al-Munawwarah. Revered for its dark tone, fine micro-wrinkles, soft bite, and profound spiritual and cardiovascular wellness properties.
products.instructions: Store in an airtight container in a cool, shaded oasis environment. Avoid moisture.

products.name: Ajwa Al-Aliya Premium
products.description: Cultivated in the prestigious high-ground gardens of Al-Aliya in Madinah. Exceptionally rich in antioxidants, selenium, and vital minerals.
products.instructions: Recommended 7 dates daily in accordance with traditional Sunnah practice.

products.name: Ajwa Seven-Day Sunnah Pack
products.description: Pre-portioned gift package containing 49 hand-inspected Ajwa dates for daily morning consumption.

products.name: Royal Medjool King Jumbo
products.description: The King of Dates. Large, plump, and glistening with natural golden-caramel skin. Lusciously soft, fibrous texture with a rich honey finish.
products.instructions: Store refrigerated for optimal firmness or at room temperature for extra softness.

products.name: Royal Medjool Select Medium
products.description: Perfect for daily snacking and desserts. Full of rich potassium, natural fructose, and iron.

products.name: Mabroom Premium Al-Madinah
products.description: Distinctive elongated form with a firm yet chewy bite. Subtle toffee sweetness with a warm amber skin.
products.instructions: Store sealed in a cool pantry.

products.name: Amber Royal Large Dates
products.description: One of the most sought-after varieties in the Kingdom. Famous for its thick flesh, dry outer crust, and soft aromatic interior.

products.name: Safawi Al-Madinah Dark Dates
products.description: Deep black-purple hue, intensely rich in flavor and natural moisture. Excellent natural stamina booster.

products.name: Sukkari Rutab (Golden Melt)
products.description: Meaning "The Sweet One". Sukkari Rutab melts effortlessly in the mouth with a golden amber color and creamy caramel undertone.

products.name: Sukkari Mufaddal Crisp
products.description: Sun-dried Sukkari with a satisfying crystallized outer sugar crunch and soft inner heart.

products.name: Roasted Almond & Pistachio Stuffed Dates
products.description: Jumbo Medjool and Amber dates pitted and filled with slow-roasted Iranian pistachios and California almonds, drizzled with floral honey.
products.instructions: Serve fresh alongside Arabic Gahwa or tea.

products.name: Belgian Dark Chocolate Enrobed Dates
products.description: Premium dates cloaked in 70% rich Belgian dark chocolate and sprinkled with crushed roasted hazelnuts.
products.instructions: Keep in a cool ambient temperature below 22°C.

products.name: Walnut & Cardamom Stuffed Dates
products.description: Filled with aromatic crushed green cardamom and buttery Kashmiri walnuts.

products.name: Pure Organic Date Molasses / Dibs (500g)
products.description: Cold-extracted from 100% natural organic dates with zero added cane sugar, preservatives, or artificial coloring. Perfect healthy replacement for honey and maple syrup.
products.instructions: Drizzle over pancakes, waffles, yogurt, tahini, or smoothies.

products.name: Artisanal Natural Date Paste (1kg)
products.description: Smooth, seedless date paste made from premium soft dates. Perfect for Maamoul cookies, raw energy bars, and culinary creations.
